1.2 Form, content, and delivery of payment instruction
The instructing agent that sends an HVCS instruction may determine the form, content, and method of delivery of the payment instruction from the debtor to the instructing agent.

A participant that receives HVCS instructions on behalf of a creditor agent pursuant to an agency arrangement must ensure that each creditor agent which it has an agency arrangement with has a SWIFT BIC to identify the creditor agent that can be provided to the debtor for inclusion in the details of the debtor's payment instruction.

A participant that sends HVCS instructions on behalf of a debtor agent pursuant to an agency arrangement must ensure that each debtor agent which it has an agency arrangement with has a SWIFT BIC that can be used by the Participant acting as an
